text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was having a meeting with Bubble Gum 
Fellow about our training schedule, but—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
choice_data_list:
Are you okay? You don't look so well 
though...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I've had a bit of a headache since this 
morning.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I don't have a fever, and my nose isn't 
stuffy, so I don't think it's a cold, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Just in case, maybe I'll take one more 
painkiller.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
choice_data_list: You seem to be happily in pain, though...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"This medicine has a super sweet coating, 
so I actually kind of like it."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. It's sweet and tasty, but there's no 
sign of the pain going away at all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow would be plagued by a 
headache for a while...
